Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 15 minutes Total time: 25 minutes Number of Servings: 7 Ingredients 8 ounces egg noodles (4 1/2 cups dry) 2 cups frozen peas 1 can (5 ounces) tuna in water, drained 1 can (10.5 ounces) condensed cream of chicken soup 1/3 cup nonfat or 1% milk 1 Tablespoon prepared mustard 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon 1/2 teaspoon onion powder 1/8 teaspoon pepper Directions Cook noodles using package directions. Add peas for last three minutes. Drain. While the noodles are cooking, mix remaining ingredients in a medium bowl. Add to drained noodles and stir well. Cook on low heat, stirring often, until heated through. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
